definition: VaryingNamedControl fixes the unchanged Models.NecessarilyUnderived.varying Ontic interpretation and selects candidate false at base false. It conjoins base reflexivity, necessity of false, its OtherDirectedPotentialCause role, NoContingentGroundOfNecessary and WellFoundedUnionNecessarySupport with R explicitly m.Causes, NamedNecessarilyUnderived for that same false, and existence of recipient true with the actual edge false→true at world true. The union overlay has one direction only. This is one joint interpretation with a genuine outgoing edge, not a claim that a necessary causer causes something at the base or that every possible cause is exercised.
note: Reuses existing varying model data and background theorems; the named underived conjunct composes the new selected-causer result. No metaphysical possibility or premise truth is established.
